title: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution
question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?

prediction.sql:
WITH stack AS (
  SELECT name, version, step, test_score
  FROM model_score
  WHERE model = 'Stack' AND step IN (1, 2, 3)
),
nonstack AS (
  SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_test
  FROM model_score
  WHERE model <> 'Stack' AND step IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY name, version, step
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ns.name
  FROM nonstack ns
  JOIN stack s
    ON s.name = ns.name
   AND s.version = ns.version
   AND s.step = ns.step
  WHERE ns.max_test < s.test_score
),
sol_counts AS (
  SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM solution
  GROUP BY name
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying q
JOIN sol_counts sc ON sc.name = q.name
WHERE CAST(q.name AS REAL) > sc.cnt
